# Clutch Academy

> Manual transmission driving school in Toronto, Ontario. Manual is also
> called stick shift or standard transmission. One-on-one lessons on real
> roads with founder-instructor Sam Anthony.

## Services

All prices + HST. Each package has its own page:

- **Individual Manual Lesson**: $90 CAD / 1 hour. Best for refreshers or a first introduction. https://clutchacademy.ca/lessons/individual
- **Manual Foundations Package**: 3 lessons for $240 CAD, $30 less than three single lessons. Goes from clutch basics to road-confident driving. Best for complete beginners. https://clutchacademy.ca/lessons/manual-foundations
- **Complete Manual Confidence Package**: 5 lessons for $400 CAD, $50 less than five single lessons. Starts from zero and covers downtown driving, highway merging, rush-hour traffic, advanced hill starts, parking. https://clutchacademy.ca/lessons/manual-confidence
- **Group Manual Lessons**: 2 hours, $180 CAD. Learn alongside a friend in a low-pressure setting. https://clutchacademy.ca/lessons/group

Overview of all options: https://clutchacademy.ca/manual-driving-lessons

## Service area

Toronto and the surrounding GTA. Lessons start in quieter areas to build confidence, then move on to real-road driving. Students choose the meeting spot when they book.

## Booking

Book online: https://calendly.com/clutchacademy-ibca

Students pay when they book. All major cards are accepted.

## Requirements

- Students must hold a valid Ontario G2 or G driver's license.
- Lessons are in a manual-transmission hatchback.
- Wear thin-soled shoes so you can feel the clutch. No sandals or open-toe shoes.

## What students learn

Clutch control and finding the bite point, smooth takeoffs, starts and stops, shifting through the gears at speed, hill starts, real-road driving in Toronto traffic. Most beginners feel confident after three lessons. Learners with some experience are often comfortable after one or two.

## Cancellation

Students get a full refund if they cancel within 24 hours of booking and at least 24 hours before the lesson. Check the current policy when booking.

## About the instructor

Samuel Anthony is the founder and lead instructor. Sam teaches manual step by step, at each student's pace, on real Toronto roads.
